meta.name: estimate-online-covariance
meta.description: Estimate a covariance / correlation / precision matrix incrementally with precise. Use when data arrives as a stream and you want the matrix updated per observation, or when you want an online (partial_fit) drop-in for sklearn.covariance, which is batch-only.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 实时更新协方差矩阵处理流式数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果数据是流式到达，需要实时更新协方差矩阵
copy.tagline_en: Update covariance matrices incrementally on streaming data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your data arrives as a stream and you need to update covariance matrices online

howto.what: 能实时处理流数据，每收到一个新样本就增量更新协方差、相关系数和精度矩阵，同时输出运行均值和已观察样本数。
howto.when: 当你描述数据流式到达、要求每个观测更新矩阵，或需要在线替代 sklearn.covariance 时触发。

say.text: 请对这段流数据逐步更新协方差矩阵。
say.note: 每次传入一个观测值，输出最新协方差。

say.text: 帮我用指数加权协方差估计器分析股票收益率流。
say.note: 使用 EwaCovariance，r参数可调衰减速度。

howto.what_en: Incrementally updates covariance, correlation, and precision matrices per new data point in a stream, also outputs running mean and sample count.
howto.when_en: Triggered when data arrives as a stream and you want per-observation updates, or need an online (partial_fit) replacement for sklearn.covariance.

say_en.text: Please incrementally update the covariance matrix for this data stream.
say_en.note: Each observation updates the state; outputs the latest covariance.

say_en.text: Use an exponentially weighted covariance estimator for stock return streams.
say_en.note: EwaCovariance with r parameter controls forgetting factor.
